options.content:
Load balance

Power per source, storage, DC/DC conversion and consumer group, and the energy per consumer over the selected time range. **Times are UTC.** All power is shown in **W** (Grafana switches to kW where it reads better), temperatures in °C. The info icon of each panel states its source and scaling. **Scaling: current vs requested.** Values not yet published in W are scaled in the dashboard; the request to Marpower is to publish them in W. | Signal | Now on MQTT | Requested | In this dashboard | |---|---|---|---| | uGrid PS/SB `PvPower` (`…dynamic-conv-ps-ara/5-11-u101`, `…dynamic-conv-sb/ara-5/12/u101`) | kW | W | × 1000 | | uGrid topic names | PS `dynamic-conv-ps-ara/5-11-u101`, SB `dynamic-conv-sb/ara-5/12/u101` | one pattern for both | both read | | Brightloop `PvPower` (`main-power-storage-errors/5-4x-y`) | kW, never negative | W, signed (charge / discharge) | × 1000, shown as is | | BMS `BatteryPower` | kW, signed | W | × 1000 | | Shore power `esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase` | kW | W | × 1000 | | Shore power `esi_bms_charge_limit_ac_power` | presumably kW | W | not shown | | Shore power `esi_ac_bus_frequency`, 70.12 TBC1a | ≈ 605, where 70.11 sends 50.05 Hz | Hz, to be checked | not shown | | 350 V DCOPP `PosLinePower`, `NegLinePower` | kW (IO list); no data since 19 Oct 2026 | W, and publish | × 1000 | | Epic power and solar `hvdc_power` (`busbar/epc-…`) | unknown, converters not running | W, to be confirmed | shown as is | | Leuze `OutputCurrent` (`24vdc-system/14ex-yyf01`) | mA, no power | A, or W per module | ÷ 1000; power computed | **Already in order:** the 10P0.1 meters (W), the power tags (W), the Weidmuller converters (W, V, A, °C), the transformer temperatures (°C). **Notes.** - **Power tags:** the overview total counts only the main switchboard 10P0-1 and 10P0-3. Their feeders to 10P1 (135Q01) and 10P2 (335Q01) are power tags themselves, so adding 10P1 and 10P2 would count those loads twice. The energy tree map leaves those two feeders out for the same reason. The power tags of 10P3 are configured but not published: nothing arrives on MQTT, and GreptimeDB holds three empty rows (29 Sep to 11 Oct 2026). Until they publish, its feeder 336Q01 on 10P0-3 is its only measurement and is shown as the group 10P3 in the tree map. - **Leuze power** is computed in this dashboard as output current × the voltage of the Weidmuller pair that feeds it, until the dbt views that compute it are deployed. The feeding converter comes from the 24 V metadata: the 14E3 modules are fed by the emergency Weidmuller W14E2_01, so they are grouped with emergency. The 16 spare modules have no known converter and use the average voltage of their bus. - **Brightloops:** `PvPower` is shown as published, without sign; the BMS battery power is shown beside it for the direction. Packs 05_42 and 05_45 publish −500 A and no power. 05_46 sent constant values (about 27 kW) on 21 Oct 2026, which inflates the brightloop total in the overview. Which brightloop is which yard tag (aft 1–4, fwd 1–2) is not settled. - **uGrid temperatures:** `TempIgbt` and `TempPowerStage` read 199 / 198 °C while a uGrid converter is not enabled. That is a fault value, not a temperature. - **350 V DCOPP:** nothing published since 19 Oct 2026, so those panels stay empty until the modules publish again. - **Solar and Epic power** converters were not running on 21 Oct 2026; their power unit is not confirmed.

panels.title: Power per group
panels.description: Total power per group, each the sum of its topics: shore power converters (`esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase` × 1000), uGrid PS and SB (`PvPower` × 1000), brightloops (`PvPower` × 1000, without sign), the Weidmuller converters of the 24 V service and emergency supply (`Power`, W), and the power tags of the main switchboard 10P0-1 and 10P0-3 (`active_power_total`, W). 10P1 and 10P2 are left out of the total, as their feeders 135Q01 and 335Q01 are power tags on 10P0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH parts AS (
  SELECT 'Shore power' AS grp, time, sum(p) AS p FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase__value) * 1000 AS p
    FROM public.marpower__450000_dc_distribution_esi WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uGrid PS', date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01'), avg(pv_power__value) * 1000
    FROM public.marpower__450000_dynamic_conv_ps_ara__5_11_u101 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'uGrid SB', date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01'), avg(pv_power__value) * 1000
    FROM public.marpower__450000_dynamic_conv_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic = 'marpower/450000-dynamic-conv-sb/ara-5/12/u101' GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Brightloops', time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(pv_power__value) * 1000 AS p
    FROM public.marpower__450000_main_power_storage_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN topic LIKE '%/w14e1-%' THEN '24 V service' ELSE '24 V emergency' END, time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(power__value) AS p
    FROM public.marpower__450000_24vdc_system WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic LIKE 'marpower/450000-24vdc-system/conv/w14e%' GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Power tags 10P0', time, sum(p) FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(active_power_total) AS p
    FROM public.power_tags WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3') GROUP BY 1, 2) t GROUP BY 2)
SELECT time, grp AS "Group", p AS "Power" FROM parts ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Shore power converters
panels.description: AC active power of the four shore power converters, `esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase` × 1000 W (sent in kW). Topic `marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-1x-tbc1{a,b}`, table `marpower__450000_dc_distribution_esi`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-11-tbc1a') THEN p END) AS "70.11 TBC1a",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-11-tbc1b') THEN p END) AS "70.11 TBC1b",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-12-tbc1a') THEN p END) AS "70.12 TBC1a",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-12-tbc1b') THEN p END) AS "70.12 TBC1b"
FROM (SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(esi_ac_bus_active_power_3_phase__value * 1000) AS p
  FROM public.marpower__450000_dc_distribution_esi
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic IN ('marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-11-tbc1a', 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-11-tbc1b', 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-12-tbc1a', 'marpower/450000-dc-distribution-esi/70-12-tbc1b')
  GROUP BY 1, 2) t
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: uGrid converters
panels.description: DC power of the uGrid converters, `PvPower` × 1000 W (sent in kW): PS 05.11-U101 on `marpower/450000-dynamic-conv-ps-ara/5-11-u101`, SB 05.12-U101 on `marpower/450000-dynamic-conv-sb/ara-5/12/u101`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, 'uGrid PS' AS "Converter", avg(pv_power__value) * 1000 AS "Power"
FROM public.marpower__450000_dynamic_conv_ps_ara__5_11_u101 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, 'uGrid SB', avg(pv_power__value) * 1000
FROM public.marpower__450000_dynamic_conv_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic = 'marpower/450000-dynamic-conv-sb/ara-5/12/u101' GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: AC grid meters 10P0.1
panels.description: Total active power of the 10P0.1 meters, PS and SB, in W as sent (`TOTALACTIVEPOWER` on `marpower/450000-dynamic-conv-{ps,sb}-general`). The AC side of the uGrid converters, for comparison.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, 'PS' AS "Meter", avg(totalactivepower__value) AS "Power"
FROM public.marpower__450000_dynamic_conv_ps_general WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, 'SB', avg(totalactivepower__value)
FROM public.marpower__450000_dynamic_conv_sb_general WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Solar converters
panels.description: `hvdc_power` of the solar converters 04.31-T101, 04.32-T101 and 04.32-T102 (`marpower/busbar/epc-3x-t10x`), as sent: the unit is not confirmed, as the converters have not run yet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-31-t101') THEN p END) AS "04.31-T101",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-32-t101') THEN p END) AS "04.32-T101",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-32-t102') THEN p END) AS "04.32-T102"
FROM (SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, topic, avg(hvdc_power__value) AS p
  FROM public.marpower__busbar
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-31-t101', 'marpower/busbar/epc-32-t101', 'marpower/busbar/epc-32-t102')
  GROUP BY 1, 2) t
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Epic power converters 700/350 V
panels.description: `hvdc_power` of the Epic power converters 02.71-T101/T102 and 02.72-T101/T102 (`marpower/busbar/epc-7x-t10x`), as sent: the unit is not confirmed, as the converters have not run yet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-71-t101') THEN p END) AS "02.71-T101",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-71-t102') THEN p END) AS "02.71-T102",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/busbar/epc-72-t101') THEN p END) AS "02.72-T101",

panels.title: 350 V DCOPP line power
panels.description: Positive and negative line power of the 350 V DCOPP modules, × 1000 W (kW according to the IO list). Topic `marpower/450000-350vdc-system/350vdc-dcoppN-mX`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, upper(split_part(topic, '-', 4)) || ' ' || upper(split_part(topic, '-', 5)) AS "Module",
  avg(pos_line_power__value) * 1000 AS "positive line", avg(neg_line_power__value) * 1000 AS "negative line"
FROM public.marpower__450000_350vdc_system
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic IN ('marpower/450000-350vdc-system/350vdc-dcopp1-m0', 'marpower/450000-350vdc-system/350vdc-dcopp1-m1', 'marpower/450000-350vdc-system/350vdc-dcopp1-m2', 'marpower/450000-350vdc-system/350vdc-dcopp2-m0', 'marpower/450000-350vdc-system/350vdc-dcopp2-m1', 'marpower/450000-350vdc-system/350vdc-dcopp2-m2')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/450000-24vdc-system/conv/w14e1-01v01') THEN p END) AS "W14E1-01V01",
  sum(CASE WHEN topic IN ('marpower/450000-24vdc-system/conv/w14e1-01v02') THEN p END) AS "W14E1-01V02",

panels.title: Power tag energy per panel
panels.description: Energy per consumer over the selected time range, grouped by panel: per-minute average of `active_power_total` (W), summed and divided by 60, in Wh. The feeders 135Q01 (10P0-1 to 10P1) and 335Q01 (10P0-3 to 10P2) are left out, as their loads appear under 10P1 and 10P2. The power tags of 10P3 are not published, so its feeder 336Q01 (on 10P0-3) is shown as the group 10P3. Consumers without energy in the range are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT group_name, item_name, sum(power) / 60 AS energy, sum(sum(power) / 60) OVER (PARTITION BY group_name) AS group_energy
FROM (SELECT date_bin('1 minute'::INTERVAL, timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time, CASE WHEN component = '336Q01' THEN '10P3' ELSE panel END AS group_name,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' AND coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN component || ' · ' || consumer WHEN coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN consumer WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' THEN component ELSE topic END AS item_name,
    avg(active_power_total) AS power
  FROM public.power_tags
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND active_power_total IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(component, '') NOT IN ('135Q01', '335Q01')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, topic, component, consumer) m
GROUP BY group_name, item_name
HAVING sum(power) > 0
ORDER BY group_name, energy DESC
